next.reason: The owner accepted JPL-001. The only current task is editable mistake-and-lesson reflection with safe local-data migration.

ownerSummary.whatIsBeingBuilt: A private local JavaScript practice log that preserves the learner's attempt, mistakes and lessons before AI provides a solution.
ownerSummary.whyThisTaskNow: Create-save-reload is accepted. The next learning risk is whether a learner can turn one attempt into a concrete mistake and lesson without expanding into retry scheduling, analytics or AI.
ownerSummary.whatNotToDo: Do not start JPL-003, add mistake scoring, backend, authentication, sync, AI hints, code execution, dashboard or gamification during JPL-002.
ownerSummary.whatComesAfter: JPL-003 may add a fresh retry flow only after JPL-002 is implemented, verified and accepted.
